text: my manceless elbow twirled my thumbs with nothing but my inner voice to talk to waiting on no one to arrive from nowhere with nothing to give to me but it kept me occupied and everywhere I looked I saw the back of my head and when I closed my eyes I saw the inside and it was bleak I could make out the faint energies that were keeping me alive exploding like clockwork clockwork my brain was kept ticking though and even though my body was lifeless I could feel life course through
